scope: Conservative Android arm64 cargo normal dependency input tree, same locked features as shipped native build; may include proc macros and code eliminated by linker. Vendored Opus and separate runtime binaries are assessed separately.

texts.origin: exact vendored Opus source used by native/build.rs

excluded: Denzic-owned application source, Android system libraries, unbundled model weights and separately attributed ONNX/sherpa binaries.
inputTextNormalization: CRLF is normalized to LF for checked-in source input hashes; bundled upstream notice text remains byte-preserved.
